subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that our annual team building event will be held next Friday at the city park. This event will be a great opportunity for us to bond and unwind together outside of the office environment. There will be team-building activities, games, and a potluck lunch. Please RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
